shared_style: rounded chibi cartoon game art, thick clean deep-brown outline, warm cel-shaded highlights, cozy polished Chinese breakfast-stall style
background: perfectly flat pure #ff00ff chroma-key background for local alpha extraction
shared_constraints: non-human ingredient art; no personification, face, eyes, hands, text, number, label, logo, watermark, cast shadow, contact shadow, floor, reflection, steam, or background scene; no #ff00ff in the subject; uniform key background with no gradient, texture, lighting variation, or shadow; crisp silhouette and generous padding

prompt_templates.ham_stock: Create exactly {quantity} round sliced ham-sausage disc(s), all individually countable and visibly outlined, arranged as a compact centered inventory grouping that fits inside a workstation ingredient slot. Use the customer portrait only as the immutable style anchor, the accepted coriander stock at the same level only for slot scale and margins, and the legacy ham stock at the same level only for subject identity, overlap direction, and exact quantity. Intended final canvas 384x384. Apply the shared style, background, and constraints.
prompt_templates.ordinary_sprite: Create {subject}. Use the customer portrait only as the immutable style anchor, the accepted ham-sausage v2 sprite only for outline, cel shading, silhouette, and padding, and the legacy source only for subject identity and composition. Composition: {layout}. Intended final canvas 256x256. Apply the shared style, background, and constraints. Preserve any source prop explicitly named in subject; otherwise add no props or containers.
